Review Pocket?

Pocket is highly praised for its simplicity and functionality, with users appreciating its ability to save and organize content for later reading. Users find it indispensable for managing information overload, with features like offline saving, categorization, and cross-device access enhancing its utility. The Chrome extension and mobile sharing options are highlighted for ease of use. Some users desire improved search functionality and integration with other cloud services. Overall, Pocket is valued for its efficiency in managing reading material.

Another frustrating aspect of the app is its behavior when users navigate away during a rest period. It is common for people to check social media or read blogs while resting between sets, but this app pauses the timer when the user switches to another app. This disruption breaks the flow of the workout and adds unnecessary frustration to the user experience. In summary, while the app's concept holds potential, its execution is severely lacking. The absence of critical features, restricted exercise options, potentially harmful recommendations, and disruptive user experience make it challenging to justify the high cost.
